testcase.name: a truncated patch is refused before anything is decompressed
a negative oldpos is out of range, not an error
offtout writes the sign in bit 63 and the magnitude below it
apply handles a negative seek and two wraparounds
a patch without the BSDIFF40 magic is refused
offtin and offtout round-trip across positive, negative and zero
offtin reads at an offset, which is how the header is parsed
a control block claiming more output than the header allows is refused
apply reports progress that ends at the declared size
bytes past the end of the old file contribute nothing
adding two bytes and truncating is addition modulo 256
offtout refuses the one magnitude the format cannot hold
